context: The wrong config file gets parsed

checklist.name: type_forces_parser
checklist.description: Explains that discovery tries every supported extension in each path before the next path, so `./app.toml` is found first, and that `SetConfigType("yaml")` forces the YAML parser on it rather than filtering by extension.

checklist.name: exact_file
checklist.description: Fixes discovery by resolving an exact `app.yaml` per search directory and calling `SetConfigFile`, or by otherwise ensuring only the intended file and format are read.

checklist.name: error_policy
checklist.description: Stops discarding the error: ignores only a discovery miss (`viper.ConfigFileNotFoundError`, matched with `errors.As` on a value target or `errors.AsType`) and returns every other error, so a missing `--config` path, an unreadable file, or a parse error fails.

checklist.name: tests
checklist.description: Adds tests with `t.TempDir()` for a sibling `app.toml`, an absent optional file, and a missing explicit `--config` path.
